interpretation: The original head scored 40/45 and the candidate 36/45 over five complete suite repeats. The four-point difference is confined to SCAN-TIME: baseline 5/5, candidate 1/5. Candidate-only non-exact quotations cite timestamp metadata instead of source wording; the same captured invalid replies are rejected by both validators. All exact captured scan citations are accepted by both. This supports model-output variability rather than a validator-caused regression. The five repeats share eight fictional scenarios and are correlated; these are descriptive results, not an accuracy estimate.
